verdict.rationale: First-party docs explain how to check a key's firmware version with Yubico Authenticator or ykman, which supports affected-model lookup. Community reports show firmware cannot be upgraded, so fixes reach users only through device replacement (free replacements during ROCA) or offered mitigations, with each account re-enrolled by hand. missing for 10: first-party security advisory pages or a vulnerability-disclosure process in the evidence, a documented affected-firmware matrix per advisory, an official replacement/remediation policy, any in-field firmware update path.
